note: Entries written by hand, merged by build_help.py into syntax_help.json (they win over generated entries of the same name). kind: meclib, object, stack, maxima. args: argument names as shown; argdocs (optional): {arg: text}.

entries.name: stack_include
entries.text: Includes Maxima code from a URL into the question variables when the question is compiled (e.g. meclib's fb_fbd.mac and fb_value.mac from GitHub). Only allowed sources work on a STACK server.

entries.name: castext
entries.text: A castext literal inside Maxima code: the string is compiled like question text, so {@...@} and [[lang]] blocks work in it. Only literal strings are allowed.

entries.name: makelist
entries.text: List of the values of expr for i from i_0 to i_1 (also makelist(expr, x, list)).

entries.name: sublist
entries.text: Elements of list for which the predicate p is true.

entries.name: sublist_indices
entries.text: Indices of the elements of list for which the predicate p is true.

entries.name: map
entries.text: Applies f to every element of list.

entries.name: lambda
entries.text: Anonymous function, e.g. lambda([x], x^2).

entries.name: block
entries.text: Evaluates the expressions in turn with local variables v_1 ... v_m; the value is the last expression (or the argument of return).

entries.name: subst
entries.text: Substitutes a for b in expr; also subst([b_1 = a_1, ...], expr).

entries.name: ev
entries.text: Evaluates expr in the environment of the arguments, e.g. ev(expr, x = 2) or ev(expr, simp).

entries.name: ratsimp
entries.text: Simplifies a rational expression (a common test whether a difference is zero).

entries.name: trigsimp
entries.text: Simplifies with sin^2+cos^2=1 and related identities.

entries.name: float
entries.text: Converts numbers in expr to floating point.

entries.name: round
entries.text: Nearest integer.

entries.name: length
entries.text: Number of elements of a list (or of the arguments of an expression).

entries.name: append
entries.text: Joins lists.

entries.name: endcons
entries.text: List with expr added at the end. E.g. deactivating an object of a copied initdata: gfbdata[2]: endcons("HIDE", gfbdata[2]) (see copylist).

entries.name: cons
entries.text: List with expr added at the front.

entries.name: first
entries.text: First element (also second ... tenth, last).

entries.name: rest
entries.text: list without its first n elements (n < 0: without its last -n elements).

entries.name: listp
entries.text: true if expr is a list.

entries.name: stringp
entries.text: true if expr is a string.

entries.name: sconcat
entries.text: Concatenates its arguments to a string.

entries.name: string
entries.text: Expression -> string, as it would be typed.

entries.name: is
entries.text: Evaluates a predicate to true or false.

entries.name: solve
entries.text: Solves equations, e.g. solve([x+y=1, x-y=0], [x, y]).

entries.name: rand
entries.text: Random number (STACK: repeatable for the variant); rand(5) gives 0 ... 4, rand([a,b,c]) an element.

entries.name: stackjson_parse
entries.text: Parses a JSON string into a Maxima structure (lists, strings, numbers); meclib questions use it for the objects input: obj: stackjson_parse(objects).

entries.name: stackjson_stringify
entries.text: Converts a Maxima list structure into a JSON string; meclib questions use it for the graphic's initial objects: init: stackjson_stringify(initdata).

entries.name: last
entries.text: Last element of list (also of an expression: its last argument).

entries.name: second
entries.text: Second element (third ... tenth likewise). Same as list[2].

entries.name: part
entries.text: Part of an expression or nested list: part(initdata, 3, 2) is initdata[3][2], the name of the third object. Index n from 1.

entries.name: delete
entries.text: list without all elements equal to expr, e.g. delete(["dim","a",[3,0.5],[4,0.5],0], initdata). delete(expr, list, n) removes the first n of them.

entries.name: member
entries.text: true if expr is an element of list, e.g. member(o[1], ["beam", "wall"]) to test the type of an object o.

entries.name: assoc
entries.text: Value for key in a list of equations or two-element lists: assoc("b", ["a"=1, "b"=2]) gives 2; default (optional, else false) if key is missing.

entries.name: reverse
entries.text: list in reverse order.

entries.name: sort
entries.text: Sorted copy of list; P (optional) is the ordering predicate, e.g. sort(L, lambda([a, b], a[2] < b[2])) sorts points by y.

entries.name: unique
entries.text: Sorted list of the distinct elements.

entries.name: flatten
entries.text: Nested lists turned into one flat list: flatten([[1,2],[3]]) is [1,2,3].

entries.name: join
entries.text: Alternating elements: join([a,b],[c,d]) is [a,c,b,d].

entries.name: firstn
entries.text: The first n elements of list (lastn(list, n): the last n).

entries.name: lmax
entries.text: Largest element of a list of numbers (lmin: smallest), e.g. for grid limits from point coordinates.

entries.name: lmin
entries.text: Smallest element of a list of numbers (lmax: largest).

entries.name: emptyp
entries.text: true for an empty list (or set or matrix).

entries.name: create_list
entries.text: Like makelist with several loop variables: create_list([i, j], i, [1, 2], j, [0, 1]).

entries.name: sum
entries.text: Sum of expr for i from i_0 to i_1. For lists of vectors: lsum(p, p, points) adds them.

entries.name: lsum
entries.text: Sum of expr for x running through list, e.g. lsum(p, p, [P1, P2, P3])/3 is the centroid of three points.

entries.name: every
entries.text: true if the predicate p is true for all elements (some: for at least one).

entries.name: some
entries.text: true if the predicate p is true for at least one element (every: for all).

entries.name: lreduce
entries.text: Combines the elements from the left with the binary function f: lreduce("+", L) is the sum of L; init (optional) is the start value.

entries.name: apply
entries.text: Calls f with the elements of list as arguments: apply(max, [1, 5, 3]) is 5, apply("+", L) the sum.

entries.name: maplist
entries.text: Like map, but always returns a list.

entries.name: outermap
entries.text: f for all combinations of the elements of the lists (nested lists).

entries.name: setify
entries.text: Set of the distinct elements (listify: back to a list).

entries.name: listify
entries.text: List of the elements of a set.

entries.name: simplode
entries.text: Strings of list joined with delim (optional): simplode(["a","b"], ", ").

entries.name: ssubst
entries.text: string with every occurrence of old replaced by new.

entries.name: sequal
entries.text: true if the two strings are equal.

entries.name: slength
entries.text: Number of characters.

entries.name: substring
entries.text: Characters from start (from 1) up to end-1; without end: to the end.

entries.name: sposition
entries.text: Position of the first char in string, false if missing.

entries.name: split
entries.text: List of the parts of string between the delimiters (delim optional, default blank).

entries.name: strim
entries.text: string without the characters of chars at both ends.

entries.name: supcase
entries.text: string in capitals (sdowncase: in small letters).

entries.name: charat
entries.text: The n-th character (from 1).

entries.name: sqrt
entries.text: Square root. Length of a vector v: sqrt(v . v).

entries.name: abs
entries.text: Absolute value.

entries.name: sin
entries.text: Sine of x in radians; for degrees sin(alpha*%pi/180).

entries.name: cos
entries.text: Cosine of x in radians; for degrees cos(alpha*%pi/180).

entries.name: tan
entries.text: Tangent of x in radians.

entries.name: asin
entries.text: Arc sine, in radians (-%pi/2 ... %pi/2).

entries.name: acos
entries.text: Arc cosine, in radians (0 ... %pi).

entries.name: atan
entries.text: Arc tangent, in radians (-%pi/2 ... %pi/2); for the angle of a vector use atan2.

entries.name: atan2
entries.text: Angle of the vector [x, y] in radians (-%pi ... %pi), all quadrants; in degrees: float(atan2(y, x)*180/%pi), e.g. the angle of a force for meclib objects.

entries.name: exp
entries.text: Exponential function e^x.

entries.name: log
entries.text: Natural logarithm (log(x)/log(10) for base 10).

entries.name: floor
entries.text: Largest integer <= x (ceiling: smallest integer >= x).

entries.name: ceiling
entries.text: Smallest integer >= x (floor: largest integer <= x).

entries.name: truncate
entries.text: x without its decimal places (towards zero).

entries.name: mod
entries.text: Remainder of x/y with the sign of y, e.g. mod(angle, 360).

entries.name: max
entries.text: Largest of the arguments (for a list: lmax or apply(max, L)).

entries.name: min
entries.text: Smallest of the arguments (for a list: lmin or apply(min, L)).

entries.name: signum
entries.text: Sign: -1, 0 or 1.

entries.name: rationalize
entries.text: Exact fraction of a decimal number (binary exact: rationalize(0.1) is not 1/10).

entries.name: expand
entries.text: Multiplies out products and powers.

entries.name: factor
entries.text: Factors a polynomial (or an integer).

entries.name: fullratsimp
entries.text: ratsimp repeated until nothing changes.

entries.name: radcan
entries.text: Simplifies roots, logarithms and exponentials into a canonical form.

entries.name: rootscontract
entries.text: Combines products of roots: sqrt(2)*sqrt(x) -> sqrt(2*x).

entries.name: trigexpand
entries.text: Expands sums of angles: sin(a+b) -> sin(a)*cos(b)+cos(a)*sin(b).

entries.name: trigreduce
entries.text: Products and powers of sin and cos into sums of multiple angles.

entries.name: num
entries.text: Numerator of a fraction (denom: denominator).

entries.name: denom
entries.text: Denominator of a fraction (num: numerator).

entries.name: coeff
entries.text: Coefficient of x^n in the expanded expr (n optional, default 1).

entries.name: ratsubst
entries.text: Substitutes a for b also where b is not a part of expr as written, e.g. ratsubst(1-sin(x)^2, cos(x)^2, expr).

entries.name: at
entries.text: expr evaluated at x = a (also for derivatives).

entries.name: psubst
entries.text: Parallel substitution: psubst([x = y, y = x], expr) swaps x and y (subst would substitute one after the other).

entries.name: diff
entries.text: n-th derivative with respect to x (n optional, default 1).

entries.name: integrate
entries.text: Integral with respect to x; with a, b the definite integral.

entries.name: limit
entries.text: Limit of expr for x -> a.

entries.name: lhs
entries.text: Left-hand side of an equation (rhs: right-hand side), e.g. rhs(solve(eq, x)[1]).

entries.name: rhs
entries.text: Right-hand side of an equation (lhs: left-hand side), e.g. rhs(solve(eq, x)[1]).

entries.name: linsolve
entries.text: Solves a system of linear equations; result is a list of equations x_i = ...

entries.name: realpart
entries.text: Real part (imagpart: imaginary part, cabs: absolute value, carg: angle).

entries.name: listofvars
entries.text: List of the variables in expr.

entries.name: freeof
entries.text: true if x does not occur in expr.

entries.name: matrix
entries.text: Matrix from rows, e.g. rotation matrix R: matrix([cos(t), -sin(t)], [sin(t), cos(t)]); R . [x, y] rotates a point (result is a column matrix: list_matrix_entries makes a list).

entries.name: list_matrix_entries
entries.text: All entries of a matrix as a list, row by row, e.g. a rotated point back to [x, y].

entries.name: transpose
entries.text: Transposed matrix (of a list: a column).

entries.name: determinant
entries.text: Determinant of a square matrix.

entries.name: invert
entries.text: Inverse matrix.

entries.name: col
entries.text: i-th column of M (row(M, i): i-th row).

entries.name: row
entries.text: i-th row of M (col(M, i): i-th column).

entries.name: genmatrix
entries.text: m x n matrix of the elements a[i, j] (a can be a lambda).

entries.name: zeromatrix
entries.text: m x n matrix of zeros (ident(n): unit matrix).

entries.name: ident
entries.text: n x n unit matrix.

entries.name: numberp
entries.text: true for a number (integer, fraction, float); not for %pi or sqrt(2).

entries.name: integerp
entries.text: true for an integer.

entries.name: floatnump
entries.text: true for a decimal number (float).

entries.name: atom
entries.text: true for a number, symbol or string (not a list or expression).

entries.name: evenp
entries.text: true for an even integer (oddp: odd).

entries.name: copylist
entries.text: Copy of a list. Needed before changing elements: after b: a, both names are the same list, and b[2]: ... changes a too. Freischnitt from the sketch: gfbdata: copylist(initdata); gfbdata[2]: endcons("HIDE", gfbdata[2]); gfbdata: append(gfbdata, [forces]).

entries.name: fb_dims
entries.text: Units of the variables of the answers, for the unit check of `fb_floats()` and `fb_dimension()`, e.g. `fb_dims: [a = "m", m = "kg", g = "m/s^2"]`. Declare every variable that occurs in the answers: an undeclared one switches the check off for its term. A name that has a value in the question variables is written as a string (`"m" = "kg"`), a dimensionless variable gets `1`. Units: m, g, s, A, K, mol, N, J, W, Pa, bar, Hz, C, V, Ohm, min, h, d, t, l, L, rad, deg, rpm, with prefixes p n u m c d h k M G T; `*` or blank, `/`, `^2`, `^-1`, `^(1/2)`, parentheses.
